definition.name: Z-Image Turbo
definition.description: Fast 6B text-to-image model; 8 steps, no negative prompt. Ships with a 2.4 GB GGUF Qwen3 text encoder (verified on the pinned sd.cpp build).

definition.name: FLUX.3 Image Klein
definition.description: Black Forest Labs' 5.6B text-to-image and editing model, distilled to 16 steps at CFG 1, with the Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder and the FLUX.2 autoencoder. It is trained on long scene captions: a detailed prompt gives a much better picture than a short one. AD_Q5_K is recommended; AD_Q4_K is the low-memory option and Q8_0 the closest to the original. The text encoder is the AD_Q4_K build (2.5 GB), measured closer to the original pictures than the common Q4_K_M. NON-COMMERCIAL LICENSE: the FLUX Kommunity License allows non-commercial use, and commercial use of outputs only for Qualifying Users (under US$5M annual revenue), under its terms. Official model: https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein. GGUF packaging and measurements by Atomic Chat: https://huggingface.co/AtomicChat/FLUX-3-Image-Klein-GGUF.

definition.name: FLUX.1 Dev Abliterated

definition.name: FLUX.1 NSFW Realism
definition.description: High-detail realistic adult FLUX.1 checkpoint for large-memory systems.

definition.name: FLUX.1 Krea Dev

definition.name: Krea 2 Turbo
definition.description: Fast 12B text-to-image model distilled for 8-step generation. Q3_K_M is the low-memory option, Q4_K_M is recommended, and Q5_K_S is the high-quality option. GATED COMMUNITY LICENSE: commercial use is subject to the Krea 2 Community License, including its revenue threshold and acceptable-use requirements; it is not unrestricted. Official model: https://huggingface.co/krea/Krea-2-Turbo. License: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/krea-ai/krea-2@db3984fbc6e13b34c0064990fc2d95ac64d00058/assets/hf_samples/LICENSE.pdf.

definition.name: Qwen-Image-2.1
definition.description: Unified 7B text-to-image and image-editing model with native RGBA output and support for up to 10 reference images. NON-COMMERCIAL ONLY: licensed for research and evaluation under the Qwen Research License; commercial use requires a separate license. Qwen is Copyright (c) 2026 Hangzhou Tongyi Laboratory Technology Co., Ltd. GGUF packaging is provided by stable-diffusion.cpp author leejet.

definition.name: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo
definition.description: Qwen-Image-2.1 distilled to 8 denoising steps at CFG 1: the same 7B text-to-image and image-editing model, several times faster, sharing the text encoder, vision projector and VAE of Qwen-Image-2.1. NON-COMMERCIAL ONLY: licensed for research and evaluation under the Qwen Research License; commercial use requires a separate license. Qwen is Copyright (c) 2026 Hangzhou Tongyi Laboratory Technology Co., Ltd. GGUF packaging is provided by Atomic Chat.

definition.name: LTX-2.3 Distilled
definition.description: Text-to-video with synchronised audio: the 22B LTX-2.3 distilled checkpoint, 8 steps at guidance 1 on its fixed sigma schedule, 24 fps, clips of 8k+1 frames up to about 10 s. Needs the Gemma-3 12B text encoder (7.4 GB) beside the transformer; about 26 GB of files at Q4_K_M. GGUF packaging by Unsloth.

definition.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B
definition.description: The small Wan 2.2 text-to-video model: 5B parameters, 24 fps, clips of 4k+1 frames, 720p; a negative prompt and classifier-free guidance apply. Needs the UMT5-XXL text encoder (3.7 GB at Q4_K_M) and the Wan 2.2 VAE beside the transformer; about 8.5 GB of files at Q4_K_M. GGUF packaging by Unsloth; the text encoder by city96.

definition.name: Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B

definition.name: Laya Multilingual

definition.name: Laya
definition.description: English decision model with calibrated answers. Short texts, up to 512 tokens.

definition.name: Laya Typed Decisions
definition.description: English decision model with calibrated answers and a longer context, up to 1024 tokens.

definition.name: Julia 1
definition.description: Small multilingual decision model. Answers yes/no, choice and score questions about a text, with 2 to 20 options, in one encoder pass.

definition.name: Laya (GGUF)
definition.description: English decision model with calibrated answers, as a GGUF for llama.cpp. Short texts, up to 512 tokens.

definition.name: lev
definition.description: English decision model on Qwen3.5 4B. Reads each answer from the logits, with calibrated probabilities over up to several hundred options.

definition.name: Kev 4B
definition.description: English decision model on Qwen3.5 4B with a pointer head over the options. Validated on documents up to 8,192 tokens.

definition.name: Bespoke Nimble 9B
definition.description: Decision model on Qwen3.5 9B by Bespoke Labs for choice and yes/no questions. Non-commercial license (CC BY-NC 4.0).

definition.name: Clef Flash
definition.description: Cloudflare decision model on Qwen3.5 9B. Decides all the questions of a request together and reads images.

definition.name: Clef
definition.description: Cloudflare's large decision model (27B). Decides all the questions of a request together and reads images. Needs about 20 GB of memory.

definition.name: OpenJev
definition.description: Large decision model (27B) for text, web pages and screenshots, with up to 52 options. Needs about 20 GB of memory. Non-commercial license (CC BY-NC 4.0).

definition.name: Gemma 4 E2B
definition.description: Smallest Google Gemma 4, quantized by Google for on-device use: chat, images, tool calling and a thinking mode in about 2.6 GB.

definition.name: Gemma 4 E4B
definition.description: Google Gemma 4 for laptops, quantized by Google for on-device use: chat, images, tool calling and a thinking mode in about 3.7 GB.

definition.name: Gemma 4 12B
definition.description: Larger Google Gemma 4 for machines with 16 GB of memory or more: stronger chat and reasoning, images, tool calling and a thinking mode.

definition.name: Qwen3 4B
definition.description: Compact Qwen text model with a thinking mode and tool calling, int8 weights. Short 4K context: best for quick questions and tool use.

definition.name: Qwen3 4B
definition.description: Qwen3 4B instruct, Q4_0. Thinking on by default, reliable tool calls, JSON by schema. On the Hexagon NPU prefill runs 3-4x faster than on the CPU (spike: 1082 tok/s vs 306), decode about the same (21 vs 18 tok/s at 12 threads: 41).

definition.name: Gemma 4 E2B
definition.description: Gemma 4 E2B instruct, QAT Q4_0, with its vision projector: images, tool calls in Gemma's own format, thinking. The small Gemma: 38 tok/s on the CPU, 31 on the NPU (spike).

definition.name: Gemma 4 E4B
definition.description: Gemma 4 E4B instruct, QAT Q4_0, with its vision projector: images, tool calls in Gemma's own format, thinking. About 7-8 GB of memory in use; no hybrid device (it crashes GenieX 0.9.3's OpenCL backend).

definition.name: Qwen3 4B (AI Hub)
definition.description: Qwen3 4B compiled by Qualcomm AI Hub for the Hexagon NPU (W4A16, 4096 context): the fastest Qwen3 here, 35 tok/s decode and 1270 tok/s prefill (spike). Thinking works; the qairt plugin passes no tools to the model and takes no JSON schema.
